answers.quote: Sir Cyril Redcliff, a British barrister who had never visited India, had no knowledge of its realities, and arrived in India five weeks before the announcement of division, defined the India-Pakistan border in an absurd and illogical manner.
answers.notes: c53: Sir Cyril Radcliffe chaired the panel that defined the India-Pakistan border at Partition.

answers.notes: c54: Jinnah became the first Governor-General of Pakistan.
